blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.
blocks.zh: 虽然从网页中挖掘平行的句子已证明对低资源机器翻译是有效的,但世界上大多数语言几乎没有网络存在。 然而,他们所拥有的资源是语言学家几个世纪努力的结果,例如语法、词典和其他文献材料。 我们建议从这些语言资源中提取翻译实例,为在线代表不足的语文提供平行数据,并有可能扩大到数千种其他语文。 我们利用光学字符识别模型和视觉语言模型(VLM),开发了实现这一目的的管道,以确保所确定的内容与视觉布局信息保持一致。 我们通过培训机器翻译模型和通过应用大语言模型的内文学习,来证明提取的比特exts对于20种语言的脚印翻译系统的效用。 对于内文学习,我们观测到+15.78和+6.94 chrF2++的改进,分别比零镜头翻译为低资源语言和高资源语言.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Modern machine translation (MT) models are typically trained on tens to hundreds of millions of parallel sentences (also termed as bitexts ).
These data are obtained by aligning parallel documents Koehn (2005) or mining from large-scale monolingual web data Schwenk et al. (2021b) ; NLLB Team et al. (2022) .
However, most of the world’s languages lack sufficient web data and, consequently, parallel sentences Joshi et al. (2020) , making data scarcity a challenge for underrepresented languages.
blocks.zh:
现代机器翻译(MT)模型通常在数以千万至数亿的平行句子(也称为比特exts)上接受训练.
这些数据是通过对平行文件Koehn(2005年)进行校正或从大规模单一语言网络数据Schwenk等人(2021b)中挖掘而获得的;NLLB Team等人(2022年).
然而,世界上大多数语言都缺乏足够的网络数据,因此,Joshi等人(2020年)的并行判决使数据稀缺成为代表性不足语言的挑战。

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential alternative through in-context learning, whereby models can adapt to new tasks from a small number of examples provided in context Brown et al. (2020) ; Wei et al. (2022) .
Recent work has used various linguistic resources, such as grammar book excerpts, dictionaries, morphological analyzers, and interlinear glossed text (IGT), to instruct LLMs to translate unseen low-resource languages Tanzer et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Ramos et al. (2025) .
Among these resources, bitext examples appear to provide the largest gains Aycock et al. (2025) , motivating our focus on extracting parallel examples.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLMs)通过内文学习提供了一种潜在的替代方法,通过这种方式,模型可以适应Brown 等人(2020年)提供的少数实例中的新任务;Wei 等人(2022年).
最近的工作利用了各种语言资源,如语法书节选,词典,形态分析器,以及线性闪烁文字(IGT),指示LLMS翻译看不见的低资源语言. Tanzer等人(2024年);Zhang等人(2024年);Ramos等人(2025年)。
在这些资源中,比特实例似乎提供了最大的收益Aycock等人。 (2025年),激励我们注重提取平行例子.

blocks.en:
Linguistic resource collections can also provide substantially broader language coverage than web-based bitext mining.
For example, the DReaM corpus Virk et al. (2020) contains grammar books, language overviews, and dictionaries covering more than 4,000 languages, whereas large-scale bitext mining typically supports only around 200 languages reliably NLLB Team et al. (2022) .
Although linguistic resources contain fewer parallel sentences, often only a few thousand, we show they can still lead to substantial improvements when used as in-context examples for MT (cf., Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
语言资源收集还可提供比基于网络的比特ext挖掘更广泛的语言覆盖面.
例如,DreaMable 程序表 维克等人. 2020年包含语法书籍,语言概览,以及涵盖4000多种语言的词典,而大规模比特ext挖掘一般只支持约200种可靠的NLLB Team et al. (2022).
虽然语言资源中包含的平行句子较少,往往只有几千句,但我们显示,如果作为MT的内文实例使用,它们仍然可以导致实质性的改进(参见图1)。

blocks.en:
Extracting structured data from heterogeneous linguistic resources at scale, however, is challenging.
Prior work either relies on resources with predefined machine-readable structure Hus and Anastasopoulos (2024) ; Tanzer et al. (2024) , or requires human effort to identify and extract relevant information based on textual and visual formatting cues Merx et al. (2024) ; Aycock et al. (2025) .
Such approaches are difficult to generalize across previously unseen resources with diverse layouts.
blocks.zh:
然而,从各种语言资源中大规模提取结构化数据是一项挑战。
先前的工作要么依靠具有预先定义的机器可读结构Hus和Anastasopoulos(2024年);Tanzer等人(2024年),要么要求人类努力根据文字和视觉格式提示Merx等人(2024年);Aycock等人(2025年)。
这种办法难以概括过去未见的资源,布局多样。

blocks.en:
Therefore, in this work, we develop an (almost) fully automatic pipeline for extracting bitexts from heterogeneous linguistic resources in PDF format from the DReaM corpus.
Our pipeline consists of two stages.
First, we apply optical character recognition (OCR) to recover text.
Second, we use a vision language model (VLM) to identify parallel sentences using both the OCR output and page image.
Visual information is important because linguistic resources often encode parallelism through visual structure that is lost in plain text, such as IGT, adjacent translations, and parallel columns.
Figure 2 shows an example of such incidental bitext.
Applying our pipeline to 20 languages, we extract an average of 2,578 bitext examples per language.
blocks.zh:
因此,在这项工作中,我们开发了一个(几乎)完全自动的管道,从DReaMacle中从PDF格式的各种语言资源中提取比特exts。
我们的管道包括两个阶段。
首先,我们采用光学字符识别(OCR)来回收文本.
第二,我们使用一种视觉语言模型(VLM),用OCR输出和页面图像来识别平行的句子.
视觉信息很重要,因为语言资源往往通过在纯文本中丢失的视觉结构编码平行主义,如IGT,相邻翻译,以及平行列.
图2显示了这种附带位图的例子。
将我们的管道应用到20种语言中,我们平均每种语言提取2,578个比特ext实例.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
We review how previous work extracts structured data from linguistic resources.
Appendix A provides additional discussion of existing bitext alignment methods.
blocks.zh:
我们回顾以前的工作如何从语言资源中提取结构化数据。
附 录 A提供了对现有比特ext对齐方法的补充讨论.

blocks.en: 2.1 Linguistic Resources Based MT
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于语言资源的MT

blocks.en:
Recent work has shown that grammar books and other linguistic resources can improve MT for unseen languages when used with LLMs Tanzer et al. (2024) .
A key challenge, however, is converting heterogeneous and poorly structured archival materials into usable structured data.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作表明,语法书籍和其他语言资源在与LLMs Tanzer等人(2024年)一起使用时,可以改善不可见语言的MT.
然而,一项关键的挑战是如何把内容多样、结构简陋的档案材料转换成有用的结构化数据。

blocks.en: Several studies leverage structured or semi-structured machine readable resources. Tanzer et al. (2024) use L a T e X and plaintext grammar books together with well-formatted parallel sentences from Dictionaria , while Aycock et al. (2025) extract parallel examples based on text formatting.
blocks.zh: 若干研究利用结构化或半结构化的机器可读资源。 Tanzer et al. (2024) 使用 L a T e X 和 plaintext 语法书籍, 以及来自 Dictionaria 的精密格式化的平行句子 . Aycock et al. (2025) 则根据文本格式提取平行实例.

blocks.en:
OCR is frequently used for archival materials.
Both Zhang et al. (2024) and Hus and Anastasopoulos (2024) use OCRed grammar books. Merx et al. (2024) OCR Mambai documents, then extract dictionaries based on text formatting and identify parallel sentences using Hunalign Varga et al. (2007) .
blocks.zh:
OCR经常用于档案材料.
张等人(2024年)和胡斯和阿纳斯塔索普洛斯(2024年)都使用OCRed语法书籍. Merx et al. (2024) OCR Mambai文件,然后根据文本格式化提取词典,并使用Hunalign Varga et al. (2007)识别平行句子.

blocks.en:
Manual intervention is sometimes needed. Zhang et al. (2025) , for example, manually extract grammar rules and parallel examples from a grammar book.
In some cases, extraction details are unspecified. Pei et al. (2025) extract parallel sentences from a dictionary without describing the procedure.
blocks.zh:
有时需要人工干预。 例如张等人(2025年),手动从文法书中摘录语法规则和平行的例子.
在某些情况下,采掘细节不详. 裴 al等. (2025)从一个词典中提取平行句子而不描述程序.

blocks.en:
Unlike this line of prior work which primarily studies how different linguistic resources and prompting strategies impact MT performance, we focus on resource construction itself.
We propose to extract useful data from archival linguistic resources with minimal manual intervention.
blocks.zh:
与以往主要研究不同语言资源及激励战略如何影响MT性能的工作不同,我们侧重于资源建设本身。
我们建议从档案语言资源中提取有用的数据,尽量减少人工干预。

blocks.en: Most closely related to our work, Setiawan et al. (2026b) combine OCR with an LLM to extract parallel sentences and lexicons from PDF grammar books, but provide limited methodological detail and evaluate only one language. Setiawan et al. (2026a) adopt a two-stage approach to leverage OCR and VLM for dictionary entry extraction, but do not consider bitext extraction or downstream MT evaluation.
blocks.zh: 与我们的工作最密切相关的是Setiawan等人(2026年b)将OCR与LLM结合,从PDF语法书中提取平行句子和词典,但提供了有限的方法细节,只评价一种语言. Setiawan等人(2026年a)采用两阶段方法,利用OCR和VLM进行字典条目提取,但不考虑比特ex提取或下游MT评价.

blocks.en: 3 Languages and Status
blocks.zh: 3 语言和状况

blocks.en:
We select extremely under-resourced languages studied in prior work, which allows us to evaluate our method using existing test sets.
Table 1 summarizes the languages and their resource status.
blocks.zh:
我们选择了在以前工作中研究的极其资源不足的语言,这使我们能够利用现有的测试集来评估我们的方法.
表1概述了各种语文及其资源状况。

blocks.en:
Our experimental design distinguishes between languages with and without web presence.
Languages supported by NLLB NLLB Team et al. (2022) have at least some, if not abundant, monolingual text online, making it likely that frontier LLMs have encountered them during pre-training.
In contrast, other languages can be treated as approximating languages that are unlikely to have been seen in LLM pre-training.
The latter group of languages allows us to simulate a setting in which a model is asked to translate a previously unseen language and the only available translation examples are extracted from archival resources.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验设计区分了有网络存在和没有网络存在的语言.
NLLB NLLB Team等人(2022年)所支持的语言在网络上至少拥有一些(如果不是丰富的话)单一语言的文本,使得边疆LLM在前期训练中有可能遇到它们.
相比之下,其他语言可被视为LLM预训中不太可能见到的近似语言.
后一组语言使我们能够模拟一种环境,要求一个模型翻译一种以前未见的语言,并从档案资源中提取唯一可用的翻译实例。

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
We extract and clean up bitexts from multilingual archival PDFs in three steps.
First, we apply multilingual OCR to recover text (Section 4.1 ).
Second, we use a VLM to identify bitext based on visual cues (Section 4.2 ).
Finally, we clean and filter the resulting alignments (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们分三个步骤从多语种档案PDF中提取和清理比特文本.
首先,我们采用多种语言的OCR来回收文本(第4.1节)。
第二,我们使用VLM来根据视觉提示识别比特ext(第4.2节).
最后,我们清理和过滤由此产生的调整(第4.3节)。

blocks.zh: 表2:合成FLORES PDF上三种OCR模型的CER.

blocks.en: 4.1 OCR
blocks.zh: 4.1 OCR系统

blocks.en:
Recently developed neural OCR models outperform traditional systems in accuracy and human-readability Poznanski et al. (2025) , but their multilingual performance had not been comprehensively benchmarked when we began this work.
We therefore evaluate 3 multilingual models, dots.ocr Li et al. (2025) , HunyuanOCR Hunyuan Vision Team et al. (2025) , and PaddleOCR-VL Cui et al. (2025) on synthetic multilingual PDFs.
blocks.zh:
最近开发的神经OCR模型在准确性和人读性上超过了传统系统波兹南斯基等人(2025年),但当我们开始这项工作时,它们的多语种性能还没有全面的基准.
因此,我们评价三个多语种模式,即:dots.ocr Li等人(2025年),HunyuanOCR 湖南远景 Team等人(2025年),以及PaddleOCR-VL Cui等人著. (2025)关于合成多语言PDF.

blocks.en:
Inspired by Ignat et al. (2022) , we render FLORES NLLB Team et al. (2022) devtest sentences into PDFs using playwright . 2 2 2 https://github.com/microsoft/playwright FLORES covers over 200 languages across 31 scripts.
We report macro-averaged character error rate (CER) across languages in Table 2 , with per-script results in Figure 3 in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
在Ignat等人(2022年)的启发下,我们利用剧作家将FLORES NLLB Team等人(2022年)的句子编成PDF. 2 2 2 2 https://github.com/microsoft/playwright FLORES涵盖超过200种语言,覆盖31个脚本.
我们在表2中报告各语文的宏观平均字符误差率(CER),在附录B中记录结果为图3。

blocks.en:
dots.ocr performs best and supports the broadest range of scripts, consistent with recent multilingual OCR benchmarks Kargaran et al. (2026) ; Xu et al. (2026) .
However, it occasionally produces endless repetitions.
Following Poznanski et al. (2025) , we retry inference with a higher temperature when generation exceeds the length limit, reducing CER from 7.88% to 5.66%.
blocks.zh:
dots.ocr 表现最好,支持最广泛的脚本,符合最近的多语种OCR基准Kargaran等人(2026年);徐等人(2026年).
然而,它偶尔会产生无尽的重复.
继波兹南斯基等人(2025年)之后,当生成量超过长度限制时,我们以更高的温度重试推论,将CER从7.88%降至5.66%.

blocks.en: 4.2 Vision Language Model
blocks.zh: 4.2 远景语言模式

blocks.en:
Incidental bitexts often exhibit certain visual properties , such as IGT or adjacent sentences in different languages (Figure 2 ).
We therefore use a VLM that takes a page image and its OCR text as input and identifies candidate bitext pairs based on visual cues.
Providing OCR text (1) avoids requiring the VLM to perform OCR, (2) leverages specialized OCR models that perform better on low-resource languages, and (3) enables the VLM to understand the content directly based on text.
blocks.zh:
偶然的比特exts经常表现出某些视觉属性,如IGT或相邻的句子用不同语言表达(图2 ).
因此,我们使用一个VLM,将一个页面图像及其OCR文本作为输入,并基于视觉提示识别候选位图对.
提供OCR文本(1)避免要求VLM执行OCR,(2)利用在低资源语言上表现较好的专门OCR模型,(3)使VLM能够直接根据文本理解内容.

blocks.en:
We assume that each book primarily contains two languages: a low-resource language (LRL) described in a high-resource language (HRL).
The LRL is obtained from the resource metadata.
We identify the HRL by applying language identification (langID) to each book, counting sentences per language, and selecting the most frequent language.
Since we target specific language directions (e.g., arp-eng ), we retain only books matching the target pair.
The VLM is expected to have substantial knowledge of the HRL and treat the remaining text as the LRL.
blocks.zh:
我们假设每本书主要包含两种语言:一种以高资源语言描述的低资源语言(LRL).
LRL来自资源元数据.
我们通过对每本书应用语言识别(langID),计算每种语言的句子,以及选择最常用的语言来识别HRL.
由于我们的目标是特定的语言方向(例如arp-eng),所以我们只保留匹配目标对的书籍.
预期VLM对HRL有丰富的了解,并将剩余文本视为LRL.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3.5-27B-FP8 Qwen Team (2026a) as the backbone VLM, served using vllm Kwon et al. (2023) .
Larger models performed substantially better in preliminary experiments, but computational constraints prevented us from using an even larger model.
Prompts are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
我们使用Qune3.5-27B-FP8 Quen Team(2026a)作为骨干VLM,服务于vllm Kwon等人(2023).
较大的模型在初步实验中表现的要好得多,但是计算上的制约使我们无法使用更大的模型.
提示载于附录C。

blocks.en: 4.3 Postprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.3 后处理

blocks.en:
Raw extracted sentence pairs are noisy.
For example, IGT may contain linguistic annotations, dictionaries may provide word-level rather than sentence-level alignments, and the VLM may produce incorrect alignments.
We therefore follow Koehn et al. (2018) ; Koehn et al. (2019) and apply language-agnostic cleaning and filtering (Section 4.3.1 ).
We additionally reconcile orthographic mismatches between archival resources and existing data using language-specific normalization (Section 4.3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
原始提取的句子对很吵
例如,IGT可能包含语言说明,词典可能提供词级而非句级对齐,而VLM可能会产生不正确的对齐.
因此,我们遵循Koehn等人(2018年);Koehn等人(2019年),并采用语言不可知性清洁和过滤(第4.3.1节)。
我们还利用特定语言的正常化,调和档案资源与现有数据之间的正字图不匹配(第4.3.2节)。

blocks.en: We do not consider such postprocessing as a disadvantage, as conventional bitext mining pipelines likewise require extensive cleaning and filtering.
blocks.zh: 我们认为这种后处理不是一种缺点,因为常规的比特ex采掘管道同样需要大量的清洁和过滤。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Language-agnostic Cleaning and Filtering
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 语言不可知论 清理和过滤

blocks.en: We apply the following language-agnostic cleaning and filtering steps: • Remove IGT annotation symbols (e.g., - , = , and ø ) from LRL sentences. • Remove pairs where either sentence contains only digits or punctuation. • Remove pairs where one sentence is more than twice as long as the other in characters. • Remove pairs where neither sentence contains more than two space-separated words. • Remove pairs with source-target Levenshtein similarity ratio above 0.9. • Apply langID to both sentences. The HRL sentence must be identified as the HRL, while the LRL sentence must not be.
blocks.zh: 我们应用以下语言不可知的清理和过滤步骤: • 从 LRL 句子中删除 IGT 注释符号(如 -, =, 和 ø). • 支助 删除只包含数字或点数的对句。 • 支助 删除一个句子比另一个字符长一倍以上的对子. • 支助 删除句子中两个空格分隔的单词。 • 消除有源目标Levenshtein相似率的对数 0.9 (英语). • 将langID适用于这两个句子。 HRL的句子必须被确定为HRL,而LRL的句子则不能被确定.

blocks.en: Remove IGT annotation symbols (e.g., - , = , and ø ) from LRL sentences.
blocks.zh: 从 LRL 句子中删除 IGT 注释符号(例如 -, =, 和 ø).

blocks.en: Remove pairs where either sentence contains only digits or punctuation.
blocks.zh: 删除只包含数字或点数的对句。

blocks.en: Remove pairs where one sentence is more than twice as long as the other in characters.
blocks.zh: 删除一个句子比另一个字符长一倍以上的对子.

blocks.en: Remove pairs where neither sentence contains more than two space-separated words.
blocks.zh: 删除句子中两个空格分隔的单词。

blocks.en: Remove pairs with source-target Levenshtein similarity ratio above 0.9.
blocks.zh: 删除有0.9以上Levenshtein相似率的对。

blocks.en: Apply langID to both sentences. The HRL sentence must be identified as the HRL, while the LRL sentence must not be.
blocks.zh: 在两个句子中应用langID. HRL的句子必须被确定为HRL,而LRL的句子则不能被确定.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Language-specific Orthography Normalization
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 特定语言的矫正

blocks.en:
Orthographic mismatch, particularly in diacritics and script, is a major challenge in the extremely low-resource settings we are studying. Oftentimes, this is because of genuine diachronic changes in the orthography preferred by language communities and other stakeholders (e.g. documentary linguists) at different times.
For all languages, we apply minor corrections for common OCR errors, identified through manual inspection of sampled book pages, plus the following language-specific normalization.
blocks.zh:
在我们研究的极低资源环境里,矫正不匹配,特别是在二极论和脚本方面,是一个重大挑战。 通常,这是因为不同时期语言群体和其他利害关系方(如纪录片语言学家)所偏爱的矫形文字发生了真正的二叠纪变化.
对于所有语言,我们对常见的OCR错误进行小的校正,通过人工检查抽查的书页来识别,加上以下针对语言的规范化.

blocks.en: We remove diacritics.
blocks.zh: 我们删除二极论。

blocks.en: We transliterate the Latin script used in our resources to the Cyrillic script used by FLORES, following an online document. 3 3 3 https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/835784/ROMANIZATION_OF_CHUVASH.pdf
blocks.zh: 我们根据在线文件将我们资源中使用的拉丁字母转换为FLORES使用的西里尔字母。 3 3 3 https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/gov/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/835784/romanization_OF_CHUVASH.pdf

blocks.en:
We remove diacritics.
The SIGMORPHON data additionally uses Combining Low Line (U+0332), e.g., K (K followed by U+0332), which our OCR model fails to recognize.

blocks.en: 6.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 6.1 主要成果

blocks.en:

Extracted bitexts substantially improve Qwen performance for all languages except dgo , with average gains of 15.78 and 6.94 chrF2++ for translation into LRLs and HRLs, respectively.

总的来说,我们显示,抽取的比特exts即使在如此小的尺度上也能提供有用的监督.

We first segment OCR text into sentences, and use a langID model to separate two languages in the book.
We then apply embedding based Global Mining , Local Mining , Vecalign , and non-embedding based Hunalign to OCRed book content page by page.
Further details are provided in Appendix E .

我们首先将OCR文本分解成句子,并使用langID模型将书中两种语言分开.
然后,我们将基于嵌入式的全球采矿、地方采矿、Vecalign和基于非嵌入式的Hunalign应用到OCRed的书籍内容页面。
详见附录E。

blocks.en:
We manually align 182 sentence pairs from randomly sampled pages of a Mambae manual Hull (2001) as groundtruths and report precision, recall, and F1 in Table 8 .
Without an auxiliary dictionary, traditional alignment methods perform poorly, while VLM achieves highest F1.
Beyond poor embedding quality, text preprocessing introduces substantial errors.
Sentence segmentation can fail when multiple parallel pairs occur on the same line or when OCR splits a single sentence across multiple lines.
LangID errors can cause sentences in the same language to be incorrectly aligned.
blocks.zh:
我们手动将曼巴手册Hull(2001年)随机抽取的两页中的182个句子对齐,作为地面真相和报告精度、回忆和表8中的F1。
没有辅助词典,传统的对齐方法表现不佳,而VLM实现最高的F1.
除了嵌入质量差之外,文本预处理还引入了大量错误.
当多个平行对子发生在同一行或者OCR将单个句子分割成多个行时,句子分割可以失败.
LangID错误可能导致同一语言的句子不正确对齐.

blocks.en:
VLM-based alignment avoids these failure modes by directly accessing images.
It can infer sentence boundaries and correspondences from visual structure without separate sentence splitting, langID, or auxiliary dictionaries, producing substantially better alignment.
blocks.zh:
基于VLM的对齐通过直接访问图像来避免这些失败模式.
它可以从视觉结构中推断出句子的边界和函式,而不单独分句,langID,或辅助词典,产生明显更好的对齐.

blocks.zh: 6.3 使用域内并行判刑进行提示

blocks.en:
Section 6.1 assumes no additional parallel examples and uses only potentially out-of-domain extracted bitexts.
As a skyline, we use available in-domain training or dev set sentences to quantify the gap between in-domain and extracted examples.

blocks.en:
Compared with book examples, in-domain examples improve the average chrF2++ from 30.40 to 38.81 for translation into LRLs and by 4.09 chrF2++ for into HRLs.
For most languages, in-domain examples substantially outperform book examples, likely due to their higher quality (Table 3 ).
Interestingly, book examples perform better in git , mgm , mnc , and ntu , possibly because more book examples are available and some books overlap with those used to construct the test sets.
It suggests that extracting bitexts from books is still a feasible way towards narrowing the gap in LRL translation when gold bitexts are unavailable.

blocks.en: 6.4 Broader Applicability: CreoleMT

blocks.en:
To examine broader applicability, we apply our pipeline to 27 of the lowest-resource Creole languages in Kreyòl-MT Robinson et al. (2024) .
Unlike our main experiments, we use only language-agnostic cleaning and filtering, without language-specific orthographic normalization.
We evaluate few-shot experiments using Qwen on the public Kreyòl-MT test set using the same evaluation metrics. Results are reported in Table 17 in Appendix F.6 .
blocks.zh:
为了审查更广泛的适用性,我们对Kreyòl-MT Robinson等人(2024年)中27种资源最少的克里奥尔语使用管道。
与我们的主要实验不同的是,我们只使用语言不可知的清洗和过滤,没有语言特有的正字法正常化.
我们用Quen在使用同一评价度量标准的公共 Kreyòl-MT 测试集上进行几度拍摄实验。 结果载于附录F.6表17。

blocks.en:
Extracted bitexts substantially improve translation into Creole languages from 16.87 to 35.71 chrF2++ on average, and translation into English from 34.54 to 48.79 chrF2++.
These results suggest that the pipeline generalizes to a broader set of low-resource languages even without language-specific human intervention.
blocks.zh:
提取的比特exts大大改进了平均16.87到35.71 chrF2++的克里奥尔语翻译,以及34.54到48.79 chrF2++的英语翻译.
这些结果表明,即使没有针对特定语言的人类干预,管道也会普遍采用更广泛的低资源语言。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce a vision language model based pipeline for extracting parallel sentences from archival linguistic resources by leveraging their visual structure.
Across more than 20 languages, few-shot translation with an LLM using the extracted bitext substantially improves low-resource MT over zero-shot translation, demonstrating the value of archival linguistic resources as a source of parallel data.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了一个基于视觉语言模型的管道,通过利用其视觉结构从档案语言资源中提取平行句子。
在20多种语言中,用提取的比特ext的LLM进行几发直译大大改善了低资源MT而不是零发直译,证明了档案语言资源作为并行数据来源的价值.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Orthography mismatches remain challenging for archival materials.
Proper normalization still requires manually designed language-specific rules, while OCR systems can struggle with diacritics and visually similar characters encoded as different Unicode code points (e.g., Latin and Cyrillic a ).
blocks.zh:
对档案材料而言,矫正不匹配仍然是挑战。
适当的正常化仍然需要人工设计的语言特异性规则,而OCR系统则可以与二极论和以不同的Unicode代码点编码的视觉相似字符(如拉丁语和西里尔语a.)进行斗争.

blocks.en:
Not all archival books are equally suitable sources of parallel data.
Many of the books in our collection were published decades ago and may use historical or outdated orthographic conventions that differ from those used in contemporary evaluation data.
Moreover, given the heterogeneous nature of archival linguistic resources, some books primarily cover topics such as phonology or grammatical descriptions and may contain relatively little parallel text useful for machine translation.
Careful resource selection is therefore important for obtaining high-quality and relevant examples.
Future advances in OCR and agentic systems might help automate these steps and further reduce manual intervention.
blocks.zh:
并非所有的档案书都是同样合适的并行数据来源。
我们收藏的许多书籍是几十年前出版的,可能采用与当代评价数据不同的历史或过时的正字法惯例。
此外,鉴于档案语言资源的多样性,一些书籍主要涵盖语音学或语法描述等专题,可能包含相对较少的平行文本,可用于机器翻译.
因此,仔细选择资源对于获得高质量和相关的例子十分重要。
OCR和代理系统今后的进展可能有助于这些步骤自动化,并进一步减少人工干预。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work on Bitext Alignment
blocks.zh: 附录A 文本对齐的相关工作

blocks.en:
Bitext alignment algorithms have been popular to create sentence-aligned bitext for training MT systems.
They can be broadly divided into bitext mining and sentence alignment.
blocks.zh:
Bitext对齐算法一直很受欢迎,用来创建用于训练MT系统的句子对齐的比特ext.
它们大致可分为位图挖掘和句子对齐.

blocks.en:
Bitext mining Schwenk et al. (2021a) ; Schwenk et al. (2021b) ; NLLB Team et al. (2022) relies on language-agnostic multilingual sentence embedding models, such as LaBSE Feng et al. (2022) , LASER Artetxe and Schwenk (2019b) ; Heffernan et al. (2022) , and SONAR Duquenne et al. (2023) , which map sentences of similar meanings to proximate points in a shared, fixed-size embedding space, regardless of the language.
In the mining process, documents collected from web are first split into sentences, and language identification (langID) is applied to group sentences by language.
Sentence embeddings are then computed for each sentence.
Margin-based embedding similarities Artetxe and Schwenk (2019a) are computed for each pair of sentences, with the ones with highest similarities are used as bitext.
The resulting bitext are often noise and require extensive filtering to improve quality Koehn et al. (2019) ; Sloto et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
Bitext 采矿 Schwenk等人(2021a); Schwenk等人(2021b); NLLB Team等人(2022年)依靠语言不可知的多语言句子嵌入模型,如LABSE Feng等人(2022年),LASER Artetxe和Schwenk(2019年b),Heffernan等人(2022年),以及SONAR Duquenne等人(2023年),这些句子将相似含义的句子映射到一个共享的,固定大小的嵌入空间中的近点,无论语言如何.
在挖掘过程中,从网络收集的文件首先被分成句子,语言识别(langID)被应用到按语言分类的分组句子中.
然后计算每一句的句子嵌入。
基于边际的嵌入相似性Artetxe和Schwenk(2019a)为每对句子计算,最相似的句子作为比特ext.
由此产生的比特ext往往是噪音,需要广泛的过滤,以提高Koehn等人的质量(2019年);Sloto等人(2023年).

blocks.en:
Another line of work, sentence alignment, assumes the availability of parallel documents.
A pair of parallel documents contain the same content but differ in language.
Sentence alignment methods typically use dynamic programming with scoring functions based on sentence lengths Brown et al. (1991) ; Gale and Church (1993) or translation Moore (2002) ; Varga et al. (2007) ; Sennrich and Volk (2010) ; Gomes and Lopes (2016) .
The state-of-the art method Vecalign Thompson and Koehn (2019) relies on sentence embeddings.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作,即句子一致,假定有并行文件。
一对平行文件包含相同的内容,但语言不同.
句子对齐方法一般使用动态编程,根据句长Brown等人(1991年);Gale和Church(1993年)或翻译Moore(2002年);Varga等人(2007年);Sennrich和Volk(2010年);Gomes和Lopes(2016年)。
最新艺术方法Vecalign Thompson和Koehn(2019年)依靠句子嵌入.

blocks.en:
Neither approach is well suited to extracting bitext from grammar books.
Unlike parallel documents, grammar books contain substantial descriptive text surrounding example sentences, making document-level sentence alignment inappropriate.
Bitext mining is more applicable, but relies on multilingual sentence representations that may generalize poorly to unseen and extremely low-resource languages Artetxe and Schwenk (2019b) ; Chimoto and Bassett (2022)
blocks.zh:
这两种方法都不适合从语法书中提取比特ext.
与平行文档不同,语法书中包含大量围绕示例句子的描述性文字,使得文档级句子的对齐不合适.
Bitext 挖掘更适用,但依赖于多种语言的句子表达方式,这些表达方式可能将一般化到不为人知的和极低的资源语言Artetxe和Schwenk(2019b);Chimoto和Bassett(2022).

blocks.en: Appendix B Script-level OCR Results
blocks.zh: 附录B 脚本级 OCR 结果

blocks.en:
We report script-level CER in Figure 3 . dots.ocr , without the retry strategy, already clearly outperforms PaddleOCR-VL and HunyuanOCR .
However, we observe that decoding with the default temperature of 0.1 0.1 sometimes degenerate repetition until the maximum generation length is reached.
Therefore, following Poznanski et al. (2025) , we retry decoding with progressively higher temperatures of 0.3 0.3 , 0.5 0.5 , and 0.8 0.8 , whenever the generated sequence reaches the maximum token limit.
This retry strategy substantially improves recognition performance for the Hang , Hant , and Hebr scripts.
blocks.zh:
我们用图3报告脚本水平的CER。
然而,我们看到,默认温度为0.1的解码有时会退化重复,直到达到最大生成长度。
因此,在波兹南斯基等人(2025年)之后,只要生成的序列达到最大信号限值,我们就会重新对温度在0.3 0.3、0.5 0.5和0.8 0.8之间逐渐升高的编码进行校正。
这种重试策略极大地提高了杭,汉特,赫伯剧本的识别性能.

Since OCR systems often fail to recognize diacritics and special letters, such as the Combining Low Line character (U+0332), we examine whether these OCR errors substantially affect downstream MT performance.
Specifically, we remove diacritics and the Combining Low Line character from both the training and test sets and re-evaluate our few-shot MT experiments for the affected languages: ddo , dik , git , gug , kmb , wol .
Our motivation is text will remain intelligible even when diacritics are omitted.

由于OCR系统往往无法识别二亚胺和特殊字母,例如组合低线字符(U+0332),我们研究这些OCR错误是否对下游MT性能有实质性的影响.
并重新评价我们为数不多的MT实验:ddo、dik、git、gug、kmb、wol。

blocks.en: Appendix E Applying Existing Alignment Methods
blocks.zh: 附录E 应用现有对齐方法

blocks.en:
Sentence alignment methods assume two documents containing the same content in different languages.
Linguistic resources such as grammar books violate this assumption, so we split the OCR text into two language-specific documents.
We segment the text into sentences using a sentence splitter, 12 12 12 https://github.com/mediacloud/sentence-splitter and then apply the langID model from NLLB Team et al. (2022) to each sentence.
Because the langID model does not support all low-resource languages, we only trust predictions of high-resource languages.
For mgm-eng , for example, sentences classified as eng are assigned to English, while all other sentences are assigned to mgm .
We then split the sentences into separate files for each language.
blocks.zh:
句子对齐方法假设两个文件包含不同语言的相同内容.
语法书等语言资源违反了这一假设,所以我们把OCR文本分成两个语言特有的文件.
我们使用一个句子分解器将文本分为句子,12 12 https://github.com/mediacloud/pentence-splitter,然后将NLLB Team等人(2022年)的langID模型应用于每一句.
因为那首歌 ID模型不支持所有低资源语言,我们只相信高资源语言的预测.
例如,对于mgm-eng,分类为eng的句子被分配到英语中,而所有其他句子则被分配到mgm.
然后我们把句子分成两种语言的单独文件。

blocks.en:
We consider two variants of sentence mining: Global Mining , applied separately to each book, and Local Mining , applied separately to each page.
For each pair of source and target sentences, we compute the margin score (Eq. 1 ) and keep the highest-scoring pairs.
Our implementation is based on stopes Andrews et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh:
我们考虑了两个句子采矿的变体:分别适用于每本书的《全球采矿》和分别适用于每页的《地方采矿》。
每对源句和目标句,我们计算比值得分(Eq. 1),并保持最高得分的对数.
我们的执行基于Stopes Andrews等人(2022年)。

blocks.en: We apply Vecalign separately to each page, using the original implementation. 13 13 13 https://github.com/thompsonb/vecalign For simplicity, we disable many-to-many alignments and allow only 1-1 alignments.
blocks.zh: 13 13 https://github.com/thompsonb/vecalign 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02. 简而言之,我们禁用多对多对齐,只允许1-1对齐.

blocks.en:
Due to the poor generalization of sentence embeddings, we also consider non-embedding-based Hunalign Varga et al. (2007) , previously used in Merx et al. (2024) for Mambai alignment.
Hunalign relies on a dictionary and sentence lengths.
We reuse the dictionary entries from Merx et al. (2024) , which were extract based on text formatting.
But we note that dictionaries are often not readily available in practice.
We apply Hunalign separately to each page.
blocks.zh:
由于嵌入式句子的概括性较差,我们也认为非嵌入式的Hunalign Varga 等人(2007年),先前在Merx 等人(2024年)中用于曼拜调和.

我们重新使用来自Merx等人(2024年)的字典条目,这些条目是根据文本格式提取的。
但我们注意到,字典在实践中往往不易获得。
我们把Hunalign分别应用到每一页.

blocks.en:
The conclusions are similar to those in the main results.
Few-shot MT yields substantial gains compared to zero-shot, with average improvements of 8.96 and 5.07 spBLEU for translation into LRLs and HRLs, respectively.
Fine-tuning nllb hurts its translation performance on languages it originally supports, but improves translation into HRLs for newly supported languages.

与零射弹相比,少发MT产生很大的收益,平均改进为8.96和5.07 spBLEU,分别用于LRLs和HRLs的翻译.
微调nllb会损害其原支持语言的翻译性能,但会改善新支持语言的HRL的翻译.

blocks.en: Appendix G Details of NLLB fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 附录G NLLB 微调的细节

blocks.en:
We fine-tune nllb-200-distilled-1.3B using LoRA adapters with rank 16 appied to all linear modules.
We use a batch size of 32 with 8 gradient accumulation steps and a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} .
The learning rate is linearly warmed up over the first 10% training steps.
blocks.zh:
我们使用LORA适配器对nllb-200-distolded-1.3B进行微调,该适配器具有16级,适用于所有线性模块.
我们使用一个32的批量大小,有8个梯度累积步骤,学习速度为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}。
在前10%的训练阶段,学习率呈线性暖化。

blocks.en: For each language not originally supported by NLLB, we add a new special language token.
blocks.zh: 对于NLLB最初不支持的每一种语言,我们都会添加一个新的特殊语言符号.

blocks.en:
To upsample lower-resource languages, we use temperature-based sampling.
The sampling probability for language i i is defined as p i = N i 1 / T ∑ j N j 1 / T \displaystyle p_{i}=\frac{N_{i}^{1/T}}{\sum_{j}N_{j}^{1/T}} where N i N_{i} denotes the number of training sentence pairs for language i i , T T is the temperature, and p i p_{i} is the probability of sampling a sentence pair from language i i at each training step.
We set T = 5 T=5 .
blocks.zh:
为了提升低资源语言,我们使用基于温度的采样.
语言i的采样概率定义为p i = N i 1 / T → j j 1 / T\displaytyle 时间轴: 其中 N i i i 表示语言 i 的训练句对数, T T 表示温度, p i p i i 表示在每个训练步骤从语言 i 中取样一对句的概率.
我们设定T=5T=5。

blocks.en: We train for 7,500 steps, corresponding to approximately 5 epochs, and use the final checkpoint for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们训练了7 500步,相当于大约5个世纪,并利用最后的检查站进行评估。

blocks.en: Appendix H Computation Resources
blocks.zh: 附录H 计算资源

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted on a single A100-80GB GPU.
OCR takes from a few minutes to several hours per book, depending on the number of pages and the script.
VLM-based bitext extraction takes approximately 20 minutes per book.
MT experiments take between 30 minutes and 36 hours per translation direction, depending on the number of input sentences and bitext examples.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是在单一的A100-80GB GPU上进行的.
OCR每本书需要几分钟到几小时的时间,这取决于页数和剧本.
基于VLM的比特ex提取每本书大约需要20分钟.
MT实验每个翻译方向需要30分钟到36小时,这取决于输入句数和比特exext实例.
